messages.subject: "branch" renamed to "layer"
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone -

Just a heads up - "branch" and other related functions have been renamed to "layer". Hopefully this will be a more intuitive interface for users.

For example, this is the old way of adding a smooth line:
  ggvis(mtcars, props(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg)) +
    mark_symbol() +
    branch_smooth(props(stroke := "red"))

And this is the new way:
  ggvis(mtcars, props(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg)) +
    mark_symbol() +
    layer_smooth(props(stroke := "red"))

-Winston

messages.body_plain:
> Would you mind sending an example of what you're trying? I'm pretty
> sure it did work when I last tried it.

Ah - ok.  One of the examples I tried was from the axes-legends vignette, which - after a bit of fixup for the newer properties syntax - looks like this:

ggvis(mtcars, props(x =~ wt, y =~ mpg),
 mark_symbol(),
 guide_axis("x", properties = list(
  axis = props(stroke := "red", strokeWidth := 5),
  grid = props(stroke := "blue"),
  ticks = props(stroke := "blue", strokeWidth := 2),
  labels = props(angle := 45, align := "left", fontSize := 20)
 ))
)

When I run this I get a plot with no hint of customisation - just the normal (thin, black) axis and tick style.  Maybe my attempted fixup is wrong?

Thanks -

Aran
